title: The header focus marker stays in view when the saved focus sits on an edge, so the Space header control never reads as missing

source.ref: Owner report 2026-09-30 after LIVE-738: "I still don't see the header focus picker in spaces." (screenshot of the Space editor's Pictures panel)

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-30. PREMISE. The owner's screenshot shows the Space editor's Pictures panel with HeaderImageField mounted (its focus hint is on screen) but no marker on the preview. The Space's saved preferences.coverFocus was "0% 0%" (read once from production 2026-09-30). ImageFocalPicker draws its 24px marker centred on the focal point with left/top set to the raw percentages inside an overflow-hidden, rounded-card frame, so a focus at an edge or corner puts the centre on the boundary and the frame clips the marker, all of it in a corner. The control was there and could be clicked, but nothing showed it. WHAT CHANGED. The marker's left and top go through markerOffset(pct) = clamp(14px, pct%, calc(100% - 14px)): half the marker plus its ring, so the whole marker always shows. The stored value, the emitted value, the pointer math and the crop (the img's object-position) are unchanged; only where the marker is drawn stops at the edge. Every ImageFocalPicker mount benefits (Space, profile, Journey, event, Circle, Channel, storefront). components/ui/image-focal-picker.test.tsx pins the clamp at 0% 0% and 100% 100%, the unclamped middle, and that the crop still reads 0% 0%; it fails on main. No migration, no data change: the owner's saved focus stays as it is.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const f="components/ui/image-focal-picker.tsx";if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.error("LIVE-740: "+f+" is gone");process.exit(1)}const s=fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8");const fail=(m)=>{console.error("LIVE-740: "+m);process.exit(1)};const helper=s.match(/function markerOffset\([^)]*\)[^{]*\{([\s\S]*?)\n\}/);if(!helper||!/clamp\(/.test(helper[1]))fail("the focal marker position is no longer clamped inside the frame, so a focus saved at an edge draws the marker out of sight");const marker=s.match(/<div[^>]*data-focal-marker[\s\S]*?\/>/);if(!marker)fail("the focal marker element is gone");if(!/left:\s*markerOffset\(x\)/.test(marker[0])||!/top:\s*markerOffset\(y\)/.test(marker[0]))fail("the marker is drawn at the raw focus percentage, so 0% 0% hides it in the corner");if(!/style=\{\{\s*objectPosition\s*\}\}/.test(s))fail("the crop no longer uses the stored focus as object-position");console.log("ok: the focal marker is drawn through the clamp and the crop keeps the stored focus")'
verify.note: Closed 2026-09-30. Reads components/ui/image-focal-picker.tsx: markerOffset clamps, the data-focal-marker element's left and top go through markerOffset(x) and markerOffset(y), and the img still crops by the stored objectPosition. Fails on main at the first arm. Exits 1 naming the file when it is gone.
